judgment_text:
Prayer

ORDER

This contempt petition has been filed to punish the respondents for disobedience of the order dated 18-6-2025 passed by this Court in W.P. No. 21452 of 2025.

2. Heard the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner and the learned Special Government Pleader appearing for the respondents.

3. The learned Special Government Pleader appearing for the respondents would submit that the petitioner's representation has been considered and passed an order on 3-2-2026.

4. Recording the above submission of the learned Special Government Pleader, this contempt petition is closed. However, if the petitioner is aggrieved with the order of the respondent, he is at liberty to proceed against such order.
